mournes_peatman.text: Mind the damp. Peat is called 'móin' in Irish, and it takes a very long time to make and a short time to burn.
Peatmonarch rules the bog. Slow and bulky, and not to be rushed. Treat it with respect, and it might return the favour.

then.text: That is all I have, I am afraid. Off you go, and mind how you go.

else.text: The Mourne Wall runs about 22 miles over 15 summits. It was built between 1904 and 1922 to protect a reservoir's water. Here, a flask.
